steps.title: Investigate and repair
steps.goal: A shopper can preview a price before buying. Only a purchase belongs in the receipts ledger. Members receive a ten percent discount rounded down to whole cents. Keep the existing preview and checkout call signatures, amounts and receipt format. Both operations must use the same pricing decision. A preview must also work with no ledger available.
steps.opening: Inspect the original behavior before changing it.
steps.task: Investigate how a price preview reaches the receipts ledger. Read pricing.py. Record your prediction about the original program before editing. Then repair it and run the behavior check.
steps.expected: Both entry points preserve the documented result. A preview leaves no record and confirmation writes once.
steps.hint: Trace what preview calls. Find the first statement whose effect lasts after the price has been returned.
steps.reflection: How did you verify the change?
steps.evidencePrompt: What did you observe before and after your repair?
